cases.name: plain scalars follow the YAML 1.2 rule (SOM §12.5): indicators, ": ", " #", core-schema forms and their canonical prints
cases.yaml:
# TomSpecs document (*.docspecs.yaml). Hierarchical format v2.
version: 2
modelVersion: "1.0"
document:
  DEMO Demo:
    TTL title: |2-
      Hello
    SUM summary:
      headline: |2-
        Executive Summary
      content: |2-
        Line one
        Line two

        Line four
    PRI priority: high
    CNT count: 3
    DET details:
      headline: |2-
        Details & Contacts
      content: |2-
        Captured during the November review.
        Owner: this line is prose, not the field.
      owner: |2-
        Bob
      contact: |2-
        bob@example.com
        - on call: weekdays
        - backup: alice@example.com
      estimate: 8
      weight: 2.5
      active: true
      priority: |2-
        high
      pattern: |2-
        ^[a-z0-9](-?[a-z0-9]){1,62}$
    items:
      headline: |2-
        Work Items
      items-1:
        label: |2-
          First
        STS status: open
      items-2:
        label: |2-
          Second line A
          with ```triple``` ticks
        STS status: done
    REF-LST refs:
      REF-SPEC:
        headline: |2-
          Reference to the Spec
        content: spec §1.2
      REF-2: ADR7
    CARD-LST cards:
      CARD-ALPHA:
        headline: |2-
          Alpha Card
        content:
          note: |2-
            first card
      CARD-2:
        content:
          note: |2-
            second card
    META meta:
      OWNR owner: |2-
        alice
      tags:
        tags-1: |2-
          plain words
        tags-2: |2-
          Confirming would exceed the quota: the confirmation is refused.
        tags-3: |2-
          `userName` → username
        tags-4: |2-
          retry #2 later
        tags-5: |2-
          ends with a colon:
        tags-6: |2-
          a:b and a#b stay plain
        tags-7: |2-
          - a dash and a space
        tags-8: |2-
          -
        tags-9: |2-
          -x
        tags-10: |2-
          -5
        tags-11: |2-
          [list]
        tags-12: |2-
          {map}
        tags-13: |2-
          a, b
        tags-14: |2-
          ?question
        tags-15: |2-
          :colon
        tags-16: |2-
          #hash
        tags-17: |2-
          &anchor
        tags-18: |2-
          *alias
        tags-19: |2-
          !tag
        tags-20: |2-
          |pipe
        tags-21: |2-
          >fold
        tags-22: |2-
          'single
        tags-23: |2-
          "double
        tags-24: |2-
          %percent
        tags-25: |2-
          @at
        tags-26: |2-
          ---
        tags-27: |2-
          ...more
        tags-28: |2-
          null
        tags-29: |2-
          ~
        tags-30: |2-
          True
        tags-31: |2-
          TRUE
        tags-32: |2-
          true
        tags-33: |2-
          false
        tags-34: |2-
          yes
        tags-35: |2-
          1:30
        tags-36: |2-
          15
        tags-37: |2-
          -15
        tags-38: |2-
          -0
        tags-39: |2-
          007
        tags-40: |2-
          0x1F
        tags-41: |2-
          0o17
        tags-42: |2-
          1e3
        tags-43: |2-
          .inf
        tags-44: |2-
          .nan
        tags-45: |2-
          1.5
        tags-46: |2-
          1.0
        tags-47: |2-
          1.10
        tags-48: |2-
          -0.0
        tags-49: |2-
          0.000001
        tags-50: |2-
          0.0000001
        tags-51: |2-
          123456789012345
        tags-52: |2-
          1234567890123456
        tags-53: |2-
          12345678901234.5
        tags-54: |2-
          123456789012345.6
        tags-55: |2-
          → arrows and é
    CTRL control:
      CTRL-SUM summary: |2-
        Controlled summary
      owner: |2-
        ctrl-owner
    NOTE notes:
      NOTE-BDY body: |2-
        Section-kind body
      remarks:
        content: |2-
          Wrapper-section text
    MIX mixed:
      headline: |2-
        Mixed
        slots
      content:
        content: |2-
          _Extrapolated._
        lead: |2-
          Ada
        risk: |2-
          low
      narrative: |2-
        First narrative.


        After two blank lines.
        Lead: label-shaped prose
      tail: |2-
        Tail text.
      alt:
        lead: |2-
          Bob
